answer: Admission runs through AeroGate, a verifier resolving an airframe registration and transponder hex against the national registry, refusing any tail number or hex bound to a licensed operator. The penalty trigger is a duplicated hex or a second airframe claiming one registration, revoking both certificates and forfeiting the performance bond. Registration costs 2200 dollars, a transponder 1500, an inspection 900, so N fakes cost N times 4600 dollars plus N airframes and inspection days. A falcon on the terrace and a quill signature change nothing, since the hex is checked at every ping.
